# Liquid Glass Kit

> Framework-independent Liquid Glass / glassmorphism materials for web apps. Package: @wpsydev/liquid-glass. CSS-first with a TypeScript DOM controller, React and Vue adapters, a Svelte action, and explicit accessible fallbacks.

- [Complete integration guide](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/llms-full.txt): Exact API, import paths, recipes, and limitations.
- [Start with one surface](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/start/): HTML/React/Vue CSS recipes, opaque mode and self-contained HTML downloads. Host-owned behavior; sample form has no assistant backend.
- [Interface design contract](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/DESIGN.md): Real tasks, readable solid content, restrained glass controls, meaningful states, and review criteria.
- [AI app design resources](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/AI_APP_DESIGN.md): Verified agent-readable design resources, component choices, evidence, selective edits and recoverable agent workflows.
- [AI interface studies](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/ai-design/): Interactive research, writing and agent workflows with clearly labelled sample data.
- [GitLab UI selection](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/UI_RESEARCH.md): Verified primary sources, framework and license tradeoffs, and the selected Pajamas ecosystem.
- [Mobile widgets](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/MOBILE.md): Touch targets, safe areas, coordinated corners, keyboard and responsive recipes.
- [Mobile research](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/MOBILE_RESEARCH.md): Apple and web-platform primary sources with compatibility boundaries.
- [Motion lab](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/motion/): Press springs, interruptible selection movement and visual appearance transitions.
- [Motion API](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/API.md): Controller options, lifecycle and adapter motion props.
- [Behavior lab](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/behavior/): Material density, tint, tone, press, indicator and scroll separation.
- [Apple comparison](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/APPLE_PARITY.md): Primary sources and remaining native gaps.
- [API](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/API.md): Defaults and lifecycle.
- [Integrations](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/INTEGRATIONS.md): Framework-specific choices.
- [Use cases](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/USE_CASES.md): Navigation, media, AI composers, overlays, and boundaries.
- [Compatibility](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Portable CSS versus experimental refraction.
- [Repository](https://github.com/wpsydev/liquid-glass-kit): Source, issues, license, and installable skill.

v0.56.0-preview.1. Install from the matching GitHub release/tag; npm publication remains pending. This file aids discovery; it does not guarantee agent indexing.

- [Experimental scene optics](docs/SCENE.md): optional WebGL2 subpath for an owned procedural background; no arbitrary DOM sampling.
- [Optics lab](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/optics/): interactive refractive lenses and original neon scene.
- [Flow studio](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/flow/): thousands of decorative WebGL2 instances, stream/wave/orbit motion and actual submission statistics.
- [Soft Matter gallery](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/fusion/): owned-scene circular glass merge/orbit/split choreography with semantic controls.
- [Circular fusion guide](docs/FUSION.md): smooth-union geometry, staged setDrops updates, own-background optics and measurement boundaries.
- [Rendering guide](docs/RENDERING.md): renderer selection, pixel budgets, map generation, measurement boundaries and native-browser evidence.

- [Anchored overlay guide](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/OVERLAYS.md): attachGlassOverlay positioning, native popover composition, motion, cleanup and scope.
- [Overlay workbench](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/overlays/): Working sample citation, model and source popovers.

- [Fast microinteractions](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/MICRO_MOTION.md): attachGlassTransition directional reveals, short feedback, cancellation and lifecycle recipes.
- [Microinteraction studio](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/micro-motion/): Six working cues on one screen; quiet at rest.
- [Motion toolbox research](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/MICRO_MOTION_RESEARCH.md): Primary references, dated adoption signals and a task-based selection.

- [Performance and simplification](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/PERFORMANCE.md): Frozen baseline, source/bundle sizes, owned resources and native-browser lifecycle samples; no global FPS claim.

- [Loading guide](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/LOADING.md): Narrow imports, component CSS, lazy scene readiness/cleanup, measured payloads and limitations.
- [Loading study](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/loading/): CSS-first navigation and an actual deferred WebGL canvas.

- [Caustic light studies](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/caustics/): six semantic UI examples with opt-in WebGL light concentration.
- [Caustic guide](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/CAUSTICS.md): exact options, current research, planar approximation and benchmark scope.

- [Glass Workbench](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/workbench/): interactive CSS editor, scoped lint, local terminal commands and native palette.
- [Workbench integration](https://github.com/wpsydev/liquid-glass-kit/blob/main/docs/WORKBENCH.md): optional semantic /tabs and /workbench.css; no editor/terminal dependency in core.

- [Magnetic dock](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/DOCK.md): optional semantic proximity magnification, focus cues, stable touch targets and lifecycle integration.
- [Orbit workspace](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/dock/): interactive creative-tool dock with opt-in12-second film tour.

- [Fieldnotes](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/scroll/): original scroll-led editorial study, working native controls and selectable fallback.

- [Activity island](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/ACTIVITY_ISLAND.md): host-owned agent sessions and review requests, optional controller and CSS, explicit host security/lifecycle responsibilities

- [Design contract](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/DESIGN_CONTRACT.md): optional pure authoring utility; typed configuration exports matching DESIGN.md, scoped CSS and own JSON, no indexing guarantee

- [Command palette](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/COMMAND_PALETTE.md): optional native modal command interface, bounded results, keyboard/focus behavior and host-owned actions

- [Composition](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/COMPOSITION.md): optional pure layout props and CSS, source order, inherited fonts, bounded reading measure and descendant container-relative headings

- [Integration brief](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/INTEGRATION_BRIEF.md): original local recipes produce an exact-import Markdown handoff for six stacks; host responsibilities and browser checks, no agent execution or discovery guarantee

- [Readability preflight](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/READABILITY.md): pure supplied-color advisory and coherent opaque fallback; no captured-pixel or WCAG conformance claim

- [Resource tree](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/RESOURCE_TREE.md): optional single-select presentation hierarchy; focus and selection separate, native focus scrolling, host-owned snapshots, all bounded nodes rendered

- [Finite feedback](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/INTERACTION_FEEDBACK.md): bounded decorative pixels/sparks/ripples after host-confirmed actions; native controls remain separate, quiet when idle

- [Native continuity](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/VIEW_TRANSITION.md): optional same-document named snapshots, exactly-once host updates, direct fallbacks and host-owned routing/focus

- [Ambient previews](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/docs/AMBIENT_MEDIA.md): opt-in video lifecycle with bounded shared previews and host-owned full players

- [Context Studio](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/preview/): original contextual panels and separate native selection action.

- [Side B](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/preferences/): original session notes, independent desk palette and native comfort utilities.

- [Review Room](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/actions/): local brief queue, review outcomes and cancellation that may outlive the client.

- [Native snap decks](docs/SNAP_DECK.md): authored card order, settled LTR/RTL view and cached targets without custom scrolling loops.
- [Offset](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/deck/): original art directions, native selection and quiet scrolling.

- [Commonplace](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/fields/): local note editor, native constraints, editable review snapshots and late-result guards.

- [Calibre](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/numbers/): local record/undo with native inputs; staged values are not measured productivity.

- [Index ledger](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/table/):18 original local rows, real editing/empty recovery and keyboard table scrolling.

- [Reversible actions](docs/REVERSIBLE_ACTION.md): actual host acknowledgments/opaque receipts, persistent Undo default, composed deadline pauses and truthful stale outcomes.
- [Kept](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/undo/): real local archive/Undo, same original item and independent history Restore.

- [Precision native number input](docs/NUMBER_INPUT.md): actual native drafts/validity/forms, optional dedicated scrub/tap controls and explicit supported-precision boundaries.
- [Hinge](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/scrub/): real local material settings after valid Commit; native editing and disclosed synthetic scrub tour.

- [Owned texture optics](docs/SCENE_TEXTURE.md): explicit experimental WebGL2 receiver for decoded host media, pixel budgets, static upload reuse and real error/context recovery.
- [REAL / SOURCE](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/texture/): original Canvas2D sources, bounded lenses, static fallback and disclosed finite optics tour.

- [Finite visual sequencing](docs/SEQUENCE.md): bounded native tracks, shared time, pause/seek/cancel and owned-style restoration without semantic callbacks.
- [Offbeat](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/sequence/): six original shapes, actual native animation controls and the same editable draft.

- [Spatial HTML anchors](docs/PROJECT_ANCHOR.md): pure explicit world/clip/CSS-pixel math, selectable depth conventions and truthful projection/frustum facts.
- [Parallax](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/anchors/): original geometry, ordinary HTML labels, native camera controls and independent screen-position evidence.

- [Trusted shader backdrops](docs/SHADER_BACKDROP.md): original GLSL, explicit clock, cached uniforms/programs, capped backing and last-good compile failure recovery.
- [Light shader studies](https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/shaders/): three original analytic styles, native controls, exact paused submission counts and finite tour.
